QF.id: IV Fixed Income Instruments and Bond Markets_28

answer.text: Converting illiquid loan assets into tradable securities via an SPV
Bank deposits being converted to bonds

explanation.text: The Logic: Securitization monetizes illiquid loan assets by transferring loans/receivables of a lender to a Special Purpose Vehicle (SPV) which issues tradable bonds against the pooled cash flows. The Trap: Securitization is not equity-to-debt conversion, government guaranteeing of bonds, or conversion of bank deposits into bonds. Note: Securitized debt is regulated by SEBI in India.
